title: `enableSqlExpressions` can never return true — the feature-flag read is dead and inverted
description: The toggle lookup is computed and discarded; both branches return false. The feature flag has zero effect. The condition is also inverted relative to the name, making any fix that returns true when enabled incorrect.

title: Default (non-`expressionParser`) path isn't gated and reports valid SQL as malformed
description: Guard lives only in `ReadQuery`, reached only when `expressionParser` is enabled. Default path runs `UnmarshalSQLCommand` which fails with 'not implemented', swallowed into BadRequest claiming SQL is invalid, breaking existing dashboards with valid SQL.

title: Flag description, docs, and frontend still advertise working DuckDB SQL expressions
description: Feature-flag registry, docs, and frontend UI advertise DuckDB SQL expressions as working when the dependency is removed and the feature is non-functional, misleading operators into enabling a broken feature.
